first_tools.name: Browser-source overlays
first_tools.text: Customizable overlays that drop into OBS, Streamlabs, Meld, or TikTok LIVE Studio as a browser source — your colors, your logo, your fonts. No installs, no downloads. This is the first tool out of the workshop.

first_tools.name: Alerts box
first_tools.text: Follows, subs, and tips popping on stream in your theme — part of the overlay engine from day one.

first_tools.name: Theme packs
first_tools.text: Six looks at launch — Neon, Clean Minimal, Retro Arcade, Cozy, Sports/Esports, Just Chatting/IRL — for any kind of content, not just one game.

first_tools.name: Chat games
first_tools.text: Spin wheels and raffles your chat plays live — the second wave, right behind the overlays.

note: Priced like a friend on purpose: a generous free tier, and Crew at 3 bucks a month when it launches — the tools are how streamers find us; the merch is the business. Built by one human and his AI superpower — the ideas are human, the execution is amplified.
statusLine: In the workshop — being built in public, right after StoreFab is dialed in.
